ui_p: NSGo apps are written in Go or TSX, and each library here is marked with the kind it is for. These are component libraries, themes and icons made for NSGo apps; NSGo’s own components are in the official docs.
ui_cta: Charts, editors, icon sets, themes: components made for NSGo are welcome.
state_p: In NSGo, state is a reactive graph that runs in Go: signals hold values, memos derive from them, and only the parts of the screen that read a value update. Community solutions build on it.
blk_signal_d: core.NewSignal holds a value. Get reads it and subscribes whatever reads it; Set and Update change it.
blk_memo_d: core.NewMemo derives a value from signals and recomputes only when they change; an effect reruns whenever what it reads changes.
blk_context_d: A key from core.NewKey hands a value to every component below the one that provides it; cx.Storage() keeps data on the device.
state_empty_h: Be the first state solution listed
state_empty_p: For example: a store built on signals, undo and redo, state persisted on the device or synced across devices.
tpl_p: nsgo init gives you a minimal app in Go, TSX or both. A template starts you further along: navigation, a component library, tests, CI and packaging already in place.
tpl_empty_p: For example: a phone app with tab navigation set up, a desktop app with a tray and windows, an app with tests and CI that builds every target.
ai_p: AI coding agents write more and more NSGo code. These skills, MCP servers and rules teach them its APIs, conventions and how to test what they build.
ai_empty_h: Be the first AI tool listed
ai_empty_p: For example: an agent skill for NSGo’s components, an MCP server that drives an app through nsgotest, AGENTS.md rules for NSGo projects.
plug_p: Official packages live in NSGo’s own module, github.com/oneo-me/nsgo: once it is in go.mod, import the ones you need.
tool_p: Create, run with hot reload, test and build NSGo apps for every target; nsgo doctor shows what this machine can build and run.
